header.running_head: Being affected by the Knowledge of Allaah and His Rasool ﷺ

blocks.text: Next to be summoned will be the one who was martyred in the path of Allaah. Allaah will ask him, 'For what objective were you killed?' His reply will be, 'because we were commanded to fight in Jihaad, I fought until I was killed.' 'You are lying,' Allaah will declare. 'You are lying,' the angels will reiterate. Allaah will then say, 'Your only motive was that people should call you a brave person, which they have already done.' Rasulullaah ﷺ then hit his hands on my knees and said, 'O Abu Hurayrah! These three will be the first of Allaah's creation with whom the fire of Jahannam will be fuelled on the Day of Qiyaamah.'"

(After hearing this Hadith from Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA)) Hadhrat Shufay then went to Hadhrat Mu'aawiya (RA) and narrated the Hadith to him. Hadhrat Alaa bin Hakeem says that Hadhrat Shufay was the person who tended to Hadhrat Mu'aawiya (RA)'s swords. He reports, "When this Hadith from Hadhrat Abu Hurayrah (RA) was narrated to Hadhrat Mu'aawiya (RA), Hadhrat Mu'aawiya (RA) remarked, 'If this is what will happen to these three, what about the rest of mankind?' He then wept so much that we thought he would expire. We said, 'This man has certainly brought a calamity upon us (by upsetting the Khalifah in this manner)!' When Hadhrat Mu'aawiya (RA) regained his composure, he wiped his face and said, 'Allaah and His Rasool ﷺ have certainly spoken the truth when they say:

blocks.arabic_text: مَنْ كَانَ يُرِيْدُ الْحَيٰوةَ الدُّنْيَا وَزِيْنَتَهَا نُوَفِّ إِلَيْهِمْ أَعْمَالَهُمْ فِيْهَا وَهُمْ فِيْهَا لَا يُبْخَسُوْنَ ۝ أُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِيْنَ لَيْسَ لَهُمْ فِي الْاٰخِرَةِ إِلَّا النَّارُ ۖ وَحَبِطَ مَا صَنَعُوْا فِيْهَا وَبٰطِلٌ مَّا كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَ ۝
blocks.text: Whoever desires the life of this world and its splendour (without a concern for the Aakhirah), We shall grant them the full rewards for their (good) deeds in this very world and they will not be wronged (they will not be given less than they deserve). They are the ones who shall have only the Fire for themselves in the Aakhirah. Whatever (good actions) they did in the world will be lost to them (in the Aakhirah) and all their (good) deeds will be in vain (because they will see no rewards for these in the Aakhirah where they will require them most. This is because they acted only for worldly objectives). [^1]

blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Abu Salamah bin Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan bin Auf (RA)
blocks.text: Hadhrat Abu Salamah bin Hadhrat Abdur Rahmaan bin Auf (RA) reports that when Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) and Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Amr bin Al Aas (RA) met at Marwa, they started discussing Ahadeeth. When Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Amr (RA) left, Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) remained there weeping. "What makes you weep so much, O Abu Abdur Rahmaan?" someone asked.
